body:
I have been takeing Ambien for almost 2yrs now
I started takeing 10mg only then went to 2x10mg so 20mgs a night
I would fight my sleep n see water ripples on the wall and pretty colors poping out my tv like 3-d
Well after so long being on it 20mg dont work no more so I take 3x10mg and boy do they work
I took all 3 10mg pills at once cracking each of them in half then about 15-30 mins later it beguins
First I feel weightless
Next my speech slurs a lil or I talk quietly
And the big bang is when I see all the ghosts in my room I even hold conversations with them
I tend to fight my sleep when I'm on them so I can have those acid effects and it works sometimes to well
My worst experience was when I was talking to a female spirit and an angry man rushed in and grabbed her and continued to beat her and I tried to help but my hands went right thru them and I stood there crying as he drug her through my bedroom wall with her hand out to me screaming please help me please
That was the only violent experience I ever had other times its just a mellow halucination that is quite fun
